claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Amcinonide is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist with no expected cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak, non-selective glucocorticoid receptor-mediated growth arrest rather than a killing pattern.
